reference.pathophysiology: Inhaled fibres and dusts persist in lung where macrophage frustration generates fibrosis and carcinogenic oxidants over decades. Heavy metals hijack haem, nerve and renal enzymes, while vitamin cofactors gate collagen, bone mineralisation, vision and energy pathways whose failure produces stereotyped deficiency syndromes.
